description: What the nightly look found: the issues worth filing, most important first. An empty list is a fine answer.

summary.description: two or three plain sentences for the owner: what you looked at, what stands out, what you left out and why

signature.description: a stable id for this problem, lowercase letters, digits and : . _ - only, the same every night and across app versions (reuse a known issue's signature for the same problem)

title.description: the issue title: what is wrong, in under 80 characters

problem.description: what users see or what is wrong in the code, one or two sentences

evidence.description: the numbers (query, sessions, versions, before vs last 24 h) or the commits and file:line it comes from

cause.description: the likely cause with file:line references, and how sure you are

suggestion.description: the change you would make, specific enough for triage to write a fix spec

regressionOf.description: a closed known issue this is the same problem as, when it is back after being closed
